findings.visible_text: ·공백 확인, 지식팩 제안, 리포트 순서로 움직이도록 (previous line ends '…규칙 검사, 충돌')
findings.expected: Figma 15:20 (step 03 body, Noto Sans KR Regular 14, line height 160%) keeps '충돌·공백' on one line ('충돌·공백 확인, 지식팩 제안, 리포트 순서로'); the reference notes say the frame breaks lines per word so Korean words are not split, and no line in the frame starts with '·'.
findings.observed: At 390 CSS px the token '충돌·공백' breaks before the middle dot, so the second line of the third paragraph starts with '·' (ink row y798-812, x52-325). The same line appears near y191 in web-390-03. At 320 the token stays whole (web-320-05), Safari 402 breaks after the dot (safari-03) and 1440 keeps it on one line.
findings.impact: A stray-looking dot opens the line and slows reading slightly; no content is lost.
findings.cause: inferred: the browser allows a line break before U+00B7 inside the compound.
findings.fix: Keep middle-dot compounds unbreakable (a no-wrap span or a word joiner around '·'), then recheck 390 and 320.

findings.visible_text: u-SAINT 학사 민원 프로토타입↗ (also 'System↗' and 'INPRO, WHYBIZ 인턴↗')
findings.expected: Figma 14:55, 14:58 and 14:61 put a word space before '↗' ('u-SAINT 학사 민원 프로토타입 ↗'); the measured gap between the last glyph and the arrow is 7-8 px in figma-390-05 (x254 to x263 for 14:58).

findings.impact: The arrow reads as attached to the last word; cosmetic only.
findings.cause: inferred: no space or margin between the title span and the arrow span.
findings.fix: Add the word space, or an equal margin, before the arrow.

figma_source_review: observed: no clipping, overlap or inconsistent spacing rule found in the export and readback; clipped frames fit their content (14:63: 14 + 10 + 145 = 169; 15:37: 119 + 32 + 67 = 218). Step 02's title leaves a one-word last line '정의' in both Figma and the 390 build; not graded.
unknowns: Interaction states: disclosure collapse/expand, link hover/focus/pressed, section-link jumps and keyboard focus are not visible in static captures.

The purple step number follows the scroll position on mobile (02 in web-390-02, 04 in web-390-03, 05 in web-390-04; 01 in safari-02 at scrollY 1028), while Figma 15:3 shows one static state with 01 current. Whether this scroll behavior is intended is unknown.
Desktop Figma fidelity: no desktop frame exists.

Desktop role choices differ from the mobile frame: the meta line is #1D1D1F above a #737374 regular question (web-1440-00); the body paragraph is #1D1D1F while process paragraphs are #737374 (web-1440-05); the body section has no '본문' label (present on mobile, 14:48) and no section rule; all desktop step numbers are purple. The summary section has no label at any width, so no internal rule is clearly broken; intent unknown.
The site footer ('GitHub 프로필 ↗', '09fa14e') lies outside the Figma frame, which ends after the related cases.
Chromium font readiness is not recorded; H1 ink extents equal Safari's (x24-306 CSS px), where Pretendard is reported loaded, so Chromium likely used Pretendard too (inferred).
Safari's toolbar is tinted amber in the device captures; whether the page or the browser sets that tint is unknown.
Not reviewed: scroll positions between captures, 200% text, text-spacing overrides, contrast and screen-reader output.

verdict.reason: No P0-P2 issue was found in any viewport group. The mobile build matches Figma node 14:2 closely in Chromium and Safari, and no text or control is clipped or covered. Five P3 implementation items remain (F1-F5: one line that starts with a middle dot at 390, a tighter arrow gap on related cases, and three desktop alignment or spacing inconsistencies); none blocks reading or navigation, so they are non-blocking follow-ups. The approval covers static visual quality only: interaction states, accessibility and desktop Figma fidelity are unknown.
